item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 FINAL #MINPRSD
Issued at 01:00 AM 16 August 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
